name: dojopay
description: Root task runner. backend/ and frontend/ stay independent npm projects with their own lockfiles.

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test:run && npm --prefix frontend run test:run
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -- --noEmit
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix backend exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: npm --prefix backend exec prisma migrate reset
